discussion.title: Who joins result publication with its own job ending and cleanup?
discussion.summary: The native front pairs the channel with the runner's ending, rejects cancellation and settles explicit cleanup before returning bytes. Compare that consumer obligation against different ownership/interface arrangements while retaining the current composition as baseline. Repository docs/components.md carries the textual contracts and source evidence.

diagrams.title: Current packages, processes and result authority
diagrams.caption: Current composition at source commit 0bdcb1f9ae24db5e9dd499308dd791744e908eb0. Boxes distinguish files, processes and Rust library responsibilities; arrows are the textual R1–R8 relations in docs/components.md. Solid arrows are labelled interactions; dotted arrows are file observations. R4, R7 and build relation R8 are expanded in the guide/sequences rather than inferred from layout. Proposed ownership changes are not drawn. Human usefulness is unassessed.

diagrams.title: A result returns only after the supervised ending and cleanup
diagrams.caption: Current successful CLI/real-policy/fake-program trace; O1–O9 refer to the guide's obligation map. The exact-result test checks byte preservation, unchanged prompt, output separation and temporary cleanup. It does not force escalation. Optional appearance polls during execution are omitted; the definitive returned signalled field is computed after reap, terminal recovery and group confirmation. PTY recovery is not a runtime observation of this fixture. Build/install O10 stays in the guide. This is a representative ordering, not all possible executions.

diagrams.title: Cancellation suppresses even an already-published result
diagrams.caption: Current cancellation paths at the same source anchor. The CLI fixture checks TERM during selection and during managed execution. A separate transport/runner fixture checks publication before TERM; it does not cover every CLI late-signal window. All three named tests passed on the investigation host. Signal interleavings, confinement and PTY cases outside those fixtures remain checked by their existing seams, not by this drawing.
